acquisition method: A data-dependent procedure that alternated between one MS scan was used, followed by 20 MS/MS scans.
cleavage agent: the sample was digested with trypsin (Promega)
fractionation method: Peptides were fractionated by high pH reverse-phase HPLC
instrument: tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q Exactive PlusTM (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: The peptides results were subjected to nano electrospray ionization (NSI) source
labeling: TMT 10-plex was selected for protein quantification.
reduction reagent: protein solution was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma)
reduction concentration: protein solution was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma)
